articles.summary: Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT) (“IRT”), a multifamily real estate investment trust (“REIT”) included in the SP MidCap 400 Index, and Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) (“Centerspace”), a multifamily REIT, today announced that, at their respective special meetings held today, IRT stockholders and Centerspace shareholders approved all of the proposals necessary for the closing of the previously announced merger pursuant to which Centerspace will merge with IRT (the “Merger”). “We greatly appreciate the support of IRT stockholders, who voted overwhelmingly in favor of the merger. Today’s vote is an exciting milestone toward creating a leading multifamily REIT focused on high-growth, non-gateway markets in the Sunbelt, Midwest, and Mountain West regions of the U.S.,” said Scott Schaeffer, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of IRT. He continued, “We are bringing together portfolios in markets that have historically delivered above-average NOI growth with lower volatility.”
articles.title: Independence Realty Trust Stockholders and Centerspace Shareholders Approve Merger
